quest.title: Orobashi's Legacy: Part IV
quest.description: Head to the agreed-upon location and report back to Kaji.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Primogem x20, Mora x10000

talks.objective: Go back and report to Kaji

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: Thanks to your efforts, the rain has stopped, the clouds have cleared, and the air is freshening up. It will take time for the Tatarigami in the atmosphere to dissipate, though.

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: *sigh* Still, my investigation here remains inconclusive. It's possible I'm overthinking it, but maybe the ruins on Fort Mumei aren't connected to the wards on the island after all— hmm?

response.speaker: Kaji
response.text: It's Fort Mumei! Fort Mumei has risen out of the sea!

response.speaker: Kaji
response.text: Let's investigate — we can't miss this opportunity!
